text:
A small Hairstyle AI Studio update 😉

You can now try five AI hairstyle generations a day without setting anything up. Recommendations do not spend that image allowance, and when the shared tier runs out you can add your own Gemini key for the current tab.

I also fixed the frustrating part where a personal key could still hit the demo's shared rate limit. Shared usage and bring-your-own-key usage now have separate limits and clearer recovery states.

Try it: https://ryanbaumann.dev/hairstyle-ai-studio/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=lab_hairstyle_free_tier_202607&utm_content=post_update_a
